float_extract_digits pushed each significant digit onto the RECURSION's
result; push appends at the end, so every digit list came out reversed
(least-significant first) while every consumer indexes 0 as most
significant — 2.5 rendered "0.000…": its digits read backward, fifteen
zeros ahead of the mantissa. The extraction now accumulates FORWARD
(push onto an acc threaded down — the one push law, O(1) snoc, tail
recursive); make_digit_list and push_digit die with their only caller.
float_floor_log10's f<1 branch also negated its recursion (−1 − r for
r − 1, wrong below 0.1) — the recurrence is now spelled as itself.

The probe chain that pinned it: parse_float forced to 2.5 still emitted
zeros; float_to_str received the true 2.5; extract truncated a real
digit 2; identity probes read exp=0 and digits[0]=0 — only the reversal
explains all four.

Morgan's challenge ("piping into for_each feels funny; minimize ceremony;
past weak-model sessions made these naming decisions") answered with
rulings written into the authority (SYNTAX §The Stage Law, §Vocabulary)
and executed across all three layers:

THE STAGE LAW: a stage-shaped fn declares configuration first, the
flowing datum LAST — declaration-order fill then completes every |>
stage with zero ceremony (xs |> map(f) |> take(3) |> fold(0, add)). A ??
inside a pipe becomes a SIGNAL: either the callee is honestly not a
stage, or the signature violates the law — fix the signature, never
decorate N call sites.

THE NAMES:
- for_each → each (69 sites). A banished keyword never returns as a fn
  name: Mentl removed `for`, and E_NotAKeyword's own Quick Fix was
  teaching people out of `for` by handing them for_each. The handler was
  named each_handler all along — the substrate already carried the true
  name; the wrapper now matches it.
- fold(xs, init, f) → fold(init, f, xs) (43 callsites, paren-aware
  reorder). The old order was the one prelude fn violating the Stage
  Law — the |> fold(??, …) holes it forced were the signature
  confessing. Those ?? dissolve (query.mn ×3, pipeline.mn, combinators).
- take(xs, n) → take(n, xs) — now symmetric with drop(n, xs).
- Ruled, named for the next sweep (283 sites):
  Hβ.lib.snoc-end-true-names — list_head/list_tail read the LAST element
  (snoc end); the borrowed cons vocabulary lies and already billed one
  real bug (the env-orientation truncation). True names: last/drop_last.
- Ruled: execution strategy never lives in a name —

mentl/dcfc933:
Two wabt-based investigation tools, promoted from one-off scripts to
named Makefile targets:

  make check-canonical   wat2wasm + wasm2wat round-trip both stages,
                         then diff. Strips syntactic noise (comments,
                         section ordering, name padding). A clean
                         diff here = semantic fixed point, regardless
                         of fresh_id ordering. Stronger guarantee
                         than the textual `make check`.

  make decompile-diff    wasm-decompile both stages, diff per-function.
                         Names the first diverging function — when
                         lux4 misbehaves at runtime but validates,
                         this localizes the miscompilation to a
                         specific function instead of "somewhere in
                         137K lines of WAT".

Both are direct consequences of CLAUDE.md's "ASK THE ARTIFACT"
protocol — wabt isn't an ad-hoc helper, it's the primary debug
oracle for self-hosting.

noodles/dc0bf81:
The chord editor draws a treble staff above the slots: the key's
actual signature, and each chord engraved as the voiceLead voicing
playback will use - inversions and register included, never textbook
root position. Spelling rides the degree-letter arithmetic through
spellChordTones (thirds stack in letters, so E#dim engraves E# G# B
and a borrowed bVI arrives as Ab C Eb), and accidentals print only
where a tone breaks the signature's promise, naturals included.
Because harmony is one chord per bar, per-chord accidentals are
engraving-correct: every slot is its own measure. The clef is a
drawn bezier path, not U+1D11E - music glyphs need a music font
neither headless Chrome nor a stock phone reliably has, and the
first receipt rendered the codepoint as nothing. Ledger lines,
clustered-second sidesteps, and the harmonyOct register shift all
render; the smoke gate asserts the staff paints beside the threads.

performances and renders mix identical samples. While a pass records,
a board rides the stage bottom: tap a chip, the sound plays now and

the export's streamed audio (slices and silence both, tails spanning

stage-level foley wire watches every puppet's squash for spikes and
fires alternating hits, derived identically in preview and render from
the same sim. A two-beat count-in precedes every punch-in so cues stop
ambushing the performer. The bit's sound can be retaken (moves kept)
or extended (new take concatenated on). Word puppets: type a phrase,
it becomes a boiling, draggable, snippable, wireable title. Corpse
mode records passes blind, earlier layers hidden until playback: the
exquisite-corpse game, nearly free. Demo v3 gains a wobbling title,
honks, and the foley wire; 38 unit tests and the e2e (sound plus text
in the fixture) stay green.
